extName: Bo doi - Measure and Inspect the Web
extDescription: Web inspector for designers & developers. Measure elements, extract CSS & colors, capture screenshots & more.

dock.sidePanelUnsupported: Side Panel Not Supported in This Browser

measure.title: Measure
measure.edgeGuidesTitle: Extend the box edges across the page
measure.hint: Drag to draw. Arrows move 1px (Shift: 10px), Ctrl+arrows expand, Ctrl+Alt+arrows shrink. Shift+↑/↓ in a field steps 10. Esc clears.

overlay.drop: Drop, paste or click to choose design images
overlay.pinTitle: Keep the image fixed while scrolling
overlay.hint: Click an image (or its thumbnail) to select it. Drag the middle to move, a corner to resize. Arrow keys nudge the selected image 1px (Shift: 10px).

audit.title: Page styles
audit.offGrid: $1 value(s) are not multiples of 4px (shown in red).
audit.allTitle: Copy all rows in this tab

capture.dragHint: Drag to select an area · Esc to cancel
capture.fastFailed: Fast capture failed ($1), used scroll & stitch instead. Close DevTools on this tab if it is open.

dialog.issueElementNotFound: Unable to locate the issue element. It may have been removed or the page may have changed.
dialog.clearElement: Are you sure you want to clear changes for this element?
dialog.clearAll: Are you sure you want to clear all changes on this page?
dialog.tabUnavailable: Couldn't communicate with the tab. Make sure Bo doi is active on the current tab.

issue.contrastAaMessage: Text has insufficient contrast ratio of $1:1 (requires $2:1 for $3 text)
issue.contrastAaRecommendation: Increase contrast to at least $1:1 for WCAG AA compliance
issue.contrastAaaMessage: Text contrast $1:1 meets AA but not AAA (requires $2:1 for $3 text)
issue.contrastAaaRecommendation: Consider increasing contrast to $1:1 for WCAG AAA compliance
issue.iconContrastMessage: Icon has insufficient contrast ratio of $1:1 (requires $2:1 for non-text elements)
issue.iconContrastRecommendation: Increase contrast to at least $1:1 for WCAG 1.4.11 compliance

missingTitle.recommendation: Add a descriptive <title> element to the page head.

titleTooShort.recommendation: Aim for 50 to 60 characters so the title is descriptive in search results.

titleTooLong.recommendation: Search engines may truncate long titles. Shorten to 50 to 60 characters.

missingDescription.recommendation: Add a meta description to summarize the page for search results.

descriptionTooShort.recommendation: Aim for 120 to 160 characters for a descriptive snippet.

descriptionTooLong.recommendation: Search engines may truncate long descriptions. Trim to 120 to 160 characters.

missingH1.recommendation: Every page should have one clear H1 that describes its main topic.

multipleH1.message: Page has more than one H1
multipleH1.recommendation: Use a single H1 per page and demote secondary headings to H2 or H3.

missingCanonical.recommendation: Add <link rel="canonical"> to declare the preferred URL for this page.

missingViewport.recommendation: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> for mobile rendering.

missingLang.recommendation: Set a lang attribute (e.g. lang="en") to help search engines and screen readers.

robotsNoindex.recommendation: Search engines will not index this page. Remove noindex if this is unintentional.

missingAlt.recommendation: Add an alt attribute to every img. Use alt="" for purely decorative images.

missingOgTitle.recommendation: Add <meta property="og:title"> so shared links display a clear title.

missingOgImage.recommendation: Add <meta property="og:image"> so shared links include a preview image.

page.pwBufferFull: Resource buffer full, some entries may be missing

edit.overriddenHidden: Overridden by a stylesheet Bo doi can't see
edit.overriddenHiddenGrant: Overridden by a stylesheet Bo doi can't see. Grant cross-origin access to reveal it.
edit.toggleDecl: Turn this declaration on or off

responsive.confirmPartialEdits: Your CSS rule changes will be kept. Inline style, markup and class edits will be discarded.
responsive.frameTimeout: This page did not finish loading.
responsive.bodyResetViewports: Your viewports will be reset to the defaults.
